name: Bitcoin
day_summary: Bitcoin slid −1.45% to ~$59,230, printing a weekend capitulation low near $59,227 before steadying. Shorts and puts kept paying; the only longs that survived were the ones that didn't use leverage.

decision.rationale: Capitulation is happening — don't sell into it, but don't buy it either. HOLD: leverage is being wiped and Fear & Greed is at extremes, yet there is no catalyst until CPI. Wait for the bounce to prove itself above $66K.

positioning.notable_flow: The bulk of weekend liquidations hit here; spot bid thin over the weekend amplified the move to the low.

what_traders_are_doing: Forced sellers and liquidations dominated a thin weekend tape; disciplined traders sat in cash waiting for the cascade to exhaust.

news.label: Weekend capitulation: BTC bottomed near ~$59,227 as ~$7B in leverage was wiped and a Mt. Gox transfer added supply uncertainty

outlook.short_term: Capitulation low in place but unconfirmed; risk asymmetric to the downside until CPI.
outlook.long_term: Unanchored — scarcity thesis intact but no valuation floor in a flows-driven drawdown.

bull_case: Extreme fear and a liquidation washout are the ingredients of a bottom.
bear_case: Thin weekend liquidity can overshoot; no fundamental floor.
ETF outflows and Strategy selling mean the structural bid is gone.
